```{r}
culture_info = read.csv(here("data", "RelativeSize_culture_info.csv"), header = TRUE)
```

#### Pipette tips {.tabset .tabset-pills}

```{r}
tips_per_box_yellow = 92
tips_per_box_blue = 92
tips_per_box_green = 24
```

```{r}
nr_cultures = max(culture_info$culture_ID)
time_points = 8
n_exchanges = 6
```

```{r}
extra_tips_factor = 1.5
```

```{r}
yellow_tips_needed = nr_cultures * time_points * extra_tips_factor

yellow_boxes_needed = yellow_tips_needed / tips_per_box_yellow
yellow_boxes_needed = ceiling(yellow_boxes_needed)

green_tips_needed = nr_cultures * n_exchanges * extra_tips_factor

green_boxes_needed = green_tips_needed / tips_per_box_green
green_boxes_needed = ceiling(green_boxes_needed)
```

Pipette tips I'll need are:

-   Yellow tips for taking the videos. I'll need `r yellow_boxes_needed` boxes for the whole experiment (`r yellow_boxes_needed/time_points` boxes per time point).

-   Green tips for exchanging resources between cultures. I'll need `r green_boxes_needed` boxes for the whole experiment (`r green_boxes_needed/n_exchanges` boxes per time point).

#### PPM & Bacterial solution {.tabset .tabset-pills}

```{r}

#Parameters for the PPM 

pellet_per_litre_needed_g = 0.46

#Parameters for the bacterial solutions

volume_bacs_bottles = 0.2

#Parameters for the high-density cultures (L)

volume_HDC = 0.2

HDC_ratio_protists = 0.10
HDC_ratio_bacs = 0.05
HDC_ratio_PPM = 0.85

n_initial_HDC = 90
n_HDC_first_check = 20
n_HDC_second_check = 20

n_HDC = n_initial_HDC + n_HDC_first_check + n_HDC_second_check
```

```{r}
extra_PPM_factor = 1.5
```

```{r}

#PPM needed

PPM_needed_for_HDC = n_HDC * volume_HDC * HDC_ratio_PPM

PPM_needed_for_bacs = n_HDC *
                      volume_HDC *
                      HDC_ratio_bacs

PPM_needed = ceiling((PPM_needed_for_HDC + PPM_needed_for_bacs) *
                       extra_PPM_factor)

pellet_needed_g = PPM_needed * pellet_per_litre_needed_g
```


```{r}

#Bacs bottles needed - Initial 

volume_initial_HDC = n_initial_HDC * volume_HDC

bacs_volume_needed_initial = volume_initial_HDC * HDC_ratio_bacs

bacs_bottles_needed_initial = ceiling((bacs_volume_needed_initial / volume_bacs_bottles) * extra_PPM_factor)

#Bacs bottles needed - First check

volume_first_check_HDC = n_HDC_first_check * volume_HDC

bacs_volume_needed_first_check = volume_first_check_HDC * HDC_ratio_bacs

bacs_bottles_needed_first_check = ceiling((bacs_volume_needed_first_check /
                                             volume_bacs_bottles) * extra_PPM_factor)

#Bacs bottles needed - Second check

volume_second_check_HDC = n_HDC_second_check *
  volume_HDC

bacs_volume_needed_second_check = volume_second_check_HDC *
  HDC_ratio_bacs

bacs_bottles_needed_second_check = ceiling((bacs_volume_needed_second_check /
                                              volume_bacs_bottles) *
                                             extra_PPM_factor)
```

-   PPM needed: `r PPM_needed` litres

-   Pellet needed: `r pellet_needed_g` grams

-   Bacs needed for the initial high-density cultures: `r bacs_bottles_needed_initial` bottles (`r volume_bacs_bottles * 1000` ml)

-   Bacs needed for the first check of the high-density cultures: `r bacs_bottles_needed_first_check` bottles (`r volume_bacs_bottles * 1000` ml)

-   Bacs needed for the second check of the high-density cultures: `r bacs_bottles_needed_second_check`bottles (`r volume_bacs_bottles * 1000` ml)

#### Protist monocultures from my collection {.tabset .tabset-pills}

```{r}
bottles_Eug_initial = 20
bottles_other_protists_initial = 7
```


```{r}

#Volume needed of Euglena to create the high-density cultures

Eug_volume_needed_initial_HDC = bottles_Eug_initial * volume_HDC

Eug_initial_needed = Eug_volume_needed_initial_HDC *
                     HDC_ratio_protists

## Volume needed of all other protists to create the high-density cultures

volume_HDC_initial_others = bottles_other_protists_initial *
                                              volume_HDC

other_protists_initial_needed = volume_HDC_initial_others *
                                HDC_ratio_protists
```

-   Volume needed from my collection to start the high-density cultures of Eug: `r Eug_initial_needed * 1000` ml

-   Volume needed from my collection to start the high-density cultures of all other protists: `r other_protists_initial_needed * 1000` ml

#### High-density cultures (HDC) {.tabset .tabset-pills}

```{r}
n_other_protists = 10
```

```{r}
extra_HDC_factor = 1.25
```

```{r}

#Volume needed of each of the high-density cultures to assemble the experiment

volume_needed_total = (sum(culture_info$patch_size_ml) * extra_HDC_factor) / 1000 

volume_needed_Eug = volume_needed_total/2
volume_needed_others = volume_needed_total/2
volume_needed_ech_protist = volume_needed_others / n_other_protists

## Euglena

bottles_HDC_Eug_needed = ceiling((volume_needed_Eug / volume_HDC))

## All other protists

bottles_HDC_other_protists_needed = ceiling((volume_needed_ech_protist / volume_HDC))
```

-   Eug high-density cultures bottles needed to assemble the experiment: `r bottles_HDC_Eug_needed` (I need `r volume_needed_Eug` litres of Eug)

-   All other protists high-density cultures bottles needed to assemble the experiment: `r bottles_HDC_other_protists_needed` per protist (I need `r volume_needed_ech_protist` litres of each other protist)

#### PPM + Bacs big bottle first time high-density {.tabset .tabset-pills}

```{r}
extra_PPM_mixing_bottle_factor = 1.20
```

```{r}

PPM_needed_for_initial_HDC = volume_initial_HDC * HDC_ratio_PPM * extra_PPM_mixing_bottle_factor

bacs_needed_for_initial_HDC = volume_initial_HDC * HDC_ratio_bacs * extra_PPM_mixing_bottle_factor

min_size_mixing_bottle = ceiling(PPM_needed_for_initial_HDC +
                                 bacs_needed_for_initial_HDC)
```

- PPM needed for the initial HDC, which I will mix into the mixing bottle: `r PPM_needed_for_initial_HDC`

- Bacterial solution needed for the initial HDC, which I will mix into the mixing bottle: `r bacs_needed_for_initial_HDC`
